summary: Phase 1 Abnehm-Guide testing. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASSED covering /achievements (fresh profile shape, consecutive streak, protein_goal badge, full_plan + water badges) and regression on /today, /goals, /schedule, /day-plan, /summary. Frontend smoke: 'Slim guide' header renders, wm-guide-btn visible next to cog, modal opens with card 1 (Protein), 6 cards navigable, final button label flips to 'Done' and closes the modal. testID-based selectors now resolve in DOM (15 data-testid elements found, vs 0 in iter87).

integration_issues.flow: Phase cards (Proteinphase/Essensfenster) & coach hint lines under timeline events
integration_issues.issue: Could not visually verify in web preview because the seeded profile (f97fdefb-…) currently has no active routine — page shows 'Start routine' CTA and rings 0/0. These elements are conditionally rendered after a routine is started. Backend data-flow already passes; recommend main agent self-verify by starting a routine in the UI or seeding fasting_schedule + day plan.

issues: Multiple console errors on every page render: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' and 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — pre-existing, not introduced by Phase 1 changes, but still spamming the console.
Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. (pre-existing)

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the recurring '<View> contains a raw text node' console error somewhere in the WM screen tree — likely a stray whitespace/string between JSX children.
(Optional) Replace deprecated transform-origin / shadow* style usage to silence warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: achievements endpoint correctly orders badges [streak_3, protein_goal, full_plan, water_goal] and always returns 4 slots — good for stable UI rendering.

today_calories_done uses a 90%-110% band (cal_now >= 0.9*target AND <= 1.1*target). The docstring says '90% of target' which is misleading — the implementation is a band, not a floor. Worth clarifying the docstring.
streak loop is bounded at 365 (safe). Longest streak scans up to 500 dates which is fine for active users.
Water 1500ml threshold is hardcoded — consider sourcing from weight_goals.daily_water_ml if available so it adapts to body-weight-based recommendations.
All 6 AbnehmGuideModal cards use proper testID; the codebase finally exposes testIDs in the DOM (15 vs 0 in iter87). Good fix.

success_rate.frontend: Smoke: 100% (header rename + guide modal 6-card flow). Phase cards + coach lines not exercised — require active routine.
